name: grid-fragment-auto-repeat-stable-placement
derivation: Stable-placement policy assumption, not a uniquely required Grid section 13 layout: accept automatic repetition and item placement once, then retain them across frame-width changes. Section 13 asks to minimize distortion but leaves exact fragmented layout undefined. On width123, repeat(auto-fill,40px) with gap1 accepts floor((123+1)/(40+1))=3 columns: 3*40+2*1=122px, with starts x0/41/82 and 1px unused. Six items occupy two rows of three. The first item in row 2 forces its entire row onto width83 at y91. Its three accepted columns still start x0/41/82, not a newly placed two-column layout. The third item ends at x122, overflowing the narrower frame by 122-83=39px. The interrupted 5px row gap is suppressed. Root fragments are 123x73 and 83x23; item rows are 17px and 23px tall.
